name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 5 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2025-12-14, at wavelengths from 1.09 to 4.82 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
